The financial statements include notes describing accounting policies, segment information, and working capital movements for the three and six months ended June 30, 2025.
ITEM 2. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations
Revenues increased by 11.6% to $245.6 million from $220.1 million due to higher commercial shipments of industrial widgets. Net income was $18.4 million compared with $15.2 million in the prior-year quarter. We declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.12 per share payable on August 31, 2025 to stockholders of record on August 15, 2025. Liquidity remained adequate and there were no covenant defaults.
